method: JSON reference and documented suede color repair only; complete BIN, nodes, pivots, normals, UVs and motion references unchanged; image extras bind separate 256px CPU GI sidecars only
precisionLimitations: UASTC and device transcoding are lossy.
16-bit source PNGs are quantized to RGBA8.
Visible KTX2 images: only dimensions above 4096 are reduced, preserving aspect ratio.
RGB normal packing is unchanged; normal-mode and normalize are not used.
Lanczos4 clamp-boundary mip filtering follows the reviewed candidates; alpha edges and repeating samplers require close-up inspection.
Source contains no redistribution license; no new public distribution permission is asserted.
CPU GI sidecars are separate 256x256 numeric RGBA8 reductions of the reviewed original PNGs; source masters and visible KTX2 images are not replaced.
